#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <cmath>
#include <climits>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

static ostream& writer = cout;

int readInt() {
    int ans = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    int c;
    bool start = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (c == '-') {
            start = true;
            neg = true;
            continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            start = true;
            ans = ans * 10 + (c - '0');
        } else if (start) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
}

long long readLong() {
    long long ans = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    int c;
    bool start = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (c == '-') {
            start = true;
            neg = true;
            continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            start = true;
            ans = ans * 10 + (c - '0');
        } else if (start) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
}

string readString() {
    string b;
    int c;
    bool start = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (!isspace(c)) {
            start = true;
            b += (char)c;
        } else if (start) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return b;
}

int readChars(char* a, int off) {
    int cnt = 0;
    int c;
    bool start = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (isalnum(c)) {
            start = true;
            a[off + cnt++] = (char)c;
        } else if (start) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return cnt;
}

class Test {
public:
    int R, C;
    vector<vector<long long>> ch;
    vector<int> cntA, cntB;
    long long best;
    string str;
    map<long long, long long> cache;
    set<long long> tried;

    Test() : ch(61, vector<long long>(61, 0)), cntA(61, 0), cntB(61, 0), best(LLONG_MAX) {}

    void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long diff = abs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
            if (diff < best) best = diff;
            return;
        }
        long long key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        if (tried.find(key) != tried.end()) return;
        if (v1 >= R) {
            long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v2][R];
            dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= R) {
            long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v1][R];
            dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        tried.insert(key);
    }

    long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long diff = abs(x - y);
        if (diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best) return 0;
        long long key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        auto it = cache.find(key);
        if (it != cache.end()) return it->second;
        if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
            if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
                int sum = v1 + v2;
                v1 -= cntA[sum];
                v2 -= cntB[sum];
                return ch[v1 + v2][v1];
            }
            return 0;
        }
        long long ans = 0;
        char c = str[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (c != 'B') {
            long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v2][R];
            ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v1][R];
            ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        cache[key] = ans;
        return ans;
    }

    void start() {
        R = readInt();
        C = readInt();
        ch = vector<vector<long long>>(2 * (R + C) + 1, vector<long long>(2 * (R + C) + 1, 0));
        cntA = vector<int>(2 * (R + C) + 1, 0);
        cntB = vector<int>(2 * (R + C) + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (R + C); i++)
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++)
                if (j == 0 || j == i) ch[i][j] = 1;
                else ch[i][j] = ch[i - 1][j - 1] + ch[i - 1][j];
        long long x = 0, y = 0;
        int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
        while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R)
            if (x > y) {
                long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
                long long other = ch[v2][R];
                y += cur * other;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
                long long other = ch[v1][R];
                x += cur * other;
                v2--;
            }
        best = abs(x - y);
        dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        str = readString();
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
            cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        long long ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        writer << ans << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    Test te;
    te.start();
    writer.flush();
    return 0;
}
